description: A high-ceilinged flat with a picture rail and a boarded-up fireplace. A kitchenette fills the old scullery. The sash window looks down Lever Lane to the Meridian. The lane is loud until two and busy again by six. The bathroom is through a panelled door at the back.

window.description: A tall sash window with the city spread out under it.
window.name: the sash window

name: Corbett Mansions, Unit 12B
